name: Technical question
trigger: a client or Ben asks how something works, whether QAD can do X, where X lives

steps.name: Ingest
steps.means: A technical question arrives by mail, Teams or a meeting; master tasks an investigation.

steps.name: Investigate
steps.means: The client agent works out the answer and hands it back.

steps.name: Ben rules on the answer
steps.means: Only if the answer raised a choice: Ben rules on it, or takes the answer as it is.
steps.gate: Ben rules on what the answer raised, or takes it as is

sla.why: refit to p75 of 26 observed stays (2026-11-15; Ben 2026-11-15)

steps.name: Reply
steps.means: The client agent drafts the reply (or the document or fix the answer calls for); nothing is sent.

steps.name: Ben reads or sends
steps.means: Ben reads it, or sends the reply; that closes the case.

sla.why: refit to p75 of 8 observed stays (2026-11-15; Ben 2026-11-15)
